verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents workspaces, model swapping and dynamic model selection, and users report being able to edit the system prompt, so separately configured assistant contexts are plausible. However, no evidence shows that each workspace or agent carries its own prompt and model, or that multiple distinct agents can run side by side. Embedded chat widgets are cited only by title and do not show routing conversations or channels to specific agents. Missing for 10: explicit per-workspace or per-agent prompt and model configuration, support for multiple distinct concurrent agents, a documented mechanism for routing conversations or channels to specific agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
